ranks: Top-5000 gap, EDHREC ranks 4159–4411 (2026-11-13): Shay Cormac and the next nine of the cards still missing from top-commander-cards.txt (B294/B318 records), built best rank first, no agents. Features: `loseKeywords` takes "protection" and "ward" (LosableKeyword) — in layer 6 at the loss's timestamp, every earlier instance of protection and each earlier ward ability, a later grant kept (Shay Cormac); PlayerScope "players-being-attacked", read from the combat's declaration record so a trigger's intervening if can ask it (Norn's Decree); the `untap-step-untapped` event and the `untaps-in-untap-step` trigger row (The Millennium Calendar); the `creatures-fought` event and the batched `creatures-fight` row (Neyith of the Dire Hunt); `outsideBattlefield.keywords`, a keyword granted to cards off the battlefield, read by cast and suspend timing (Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir); the embalm mark on its tokens and `CopyOnEnter.exceptIfEmbalmed` (Vizier of Many Faces); a `discards` trigger's cards as its batch (Conspiracy Theorist); `drawsInOpponentsDrawStep` and `untapsDuringOthersUntap` off an emblem (Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset); `choose-value`'s counter-kind on a player, and `add-counter` at a player (Animation Module). Benthic Anomaly needed no engine code (vote's `about`, a choose-permanents over `thisWay: "chosen"`, an aggregate over it). No majors: Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset's emblem, guessed major, was a draw-step hook.

blocked.name: Jinnie Fay, Jetmir's Second
blocked.why: Not reached. Researched: Flitwing's `may` + `becomes` replaces the whole event, so the effect's riders are lost (tapped, attacking, "it gains haste", exiled at end of combat — the ruling keeps them); `tokensInstead` keeps them but is one fixed token every replacement must apply (`token-replacements.ts`'s search takes no optional ones). Needs an optional `tokensInstead` with a choice of token: ask the creating player as-is / Cats / Dogs where `ctx.tokenEventReplaced` asks a `may` today (a choose-modes), then carry the chosen name into that one event's plan as a `tokensInstead` over every token of it.

blocked.name: Cephalid Snitch
blocked.why: 'Target creature loses protection from black until end of turn': `loseKeywords`' "protection" (built here for Shay Cormac) takes every instance; one quality alone, the others kept, has no form. Was keyed effect:lose-protection-and-ward (B220).
